response.reason: The butterfly computes natural-order (Hadamard) coefficients exactly in int32 (max magnitude 4194304 fits), and the permutation result[k] = value[bitreverse(gray(k))] is the standard mapping from natural order to sequency (Walsh) order: sequency index k corresponds to Hadamard row bit-reverse(gray(k)), whose sign-change count equals k. This matches the reference's argsort-by-sign-changes construction.
